items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: when I would write for him, he would hear harmonies that he never heard before

ctx.x: Talk about your relationship with him, what kind of a guy he was.

Jack was as easy going a person as I've ever come across. He probably could handle anything that happened, nothing seemed to phase him. He was amused by me, he used to call me the Professor, because when I would write for him, he would hear harmonies that he never heard before, sounds that he didn't think could come out of bands, so he called me the Professor.

I did a chart on "Body and Soul" for him that I wish I had today; I really worked on it, worked very hard, one of the few times I worked hard to accomplish something and it must have been very involved because he gave me that questioning look at times, that amused look, the Professor's at it again, but he was an amazing
